# Zhihua Moulds

> Factory-direct Chinese manufacturer of injection-moulded plastic moulds (PP and ABS) for precast concrete. Founded 2015, 9,213 m² facility in Jiaxing/Haiyan, Zhejiang, 1,000+ standard mould designs, exporting to 30+ countries across the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, CIS, Latin America, Europe and Oceania. Typical service life 150+ concrete casting cycles per mould.

Zhihua Moulds (Jiaxing Zhihua Technology Co., Ltd., 嘉兴市志华科技股份有限公司) supplies plastic moulds used by precast concrete factories to cast manhole covers and shaft bricks, kerbstones/curbstones, pavers, drainage channels and covers, cable trenches, slope protection blocks, photovoltaic pier bases, rail transit components, landscape concrete and custom OEM parts. Every listed product page carries a Product schema and a buyer FAQ; moulds are produced in virgin polypropylene (PP) or ABS only — no silicone, rubber or polyurethane moulds.

## Key Facts

- Legal entity: Jiaxing Zhihua Technology Co., Ltd.
- Founded: 2015 · Employees: about 50 · Facility: 9,213 m²
- Location: No. 399, Yongkang Road, Shendang Industrial Park, Haiyan County, Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China 314300
- Materials: injection-moulded virgin PP and ABS only
- Service life: 150+ concrete pour cycles under normal use
- Catalogue: 1,000+ standard designs plus custom OEM from drawings, CAD files, photos or physical samples
- Lead time: typically 15-30 days after design approval; MOQ and pricing per item
- Export: 20'/40' containers, flat-rack and open-top; mixed-SKU loading supported
- Load classes (D400/F900 etc.) are never marked on moulds — load capacity belongs to the reinforced concrete design, not the mould
- Contact: WhatsApp +86-166-2139-1202 · anna@zhihuamoulds.com

## Product Categories

- [Arch Framework Slope Protection Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/arch-framework-slope-moulds): Factory-direct arch framework slope protection moulds: straight and curved arch beams (R75–R225), complete A–H / No.1–5 piece sets for inner Ø2.5m & Ø3m arch rings, L-type side beams and frame-grid blocks
- [Breeze Block & Decorative Screen Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/breeze-block-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for concrete breeze blocks, decorative screen blocks and perforated wall blocks
- [Road Shoulder Stone & Bridge Cap Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/bridge-cap-road-shoulder-moulds): Factory-direct road shoulder stone moulds (flat, sloped, beveled, perforated, notched), shoulder cover slabs & retaining blocks, plus bridge cap & L-shaped cap coping moulds — 36 moulds from 8cm to 33.5cm, PP & ABS, OEM.
- [Cable Trench Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/cable-trench-moulds): Factory-direct cable trench cover moulds — removable lift-handle power cable duct covers (60×40 to 170×50cm), metro/subway and deep-burial tunnel trough covers, PP & ABS
- [Cobblestone Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/cobblestone-drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct cobblestone-pattern concrete cover moulds: plain, notched (pipe/cable crossing), 2-hole/4-hole perforated and railway-standard (Tie Biao) trench & ditch covers, 29.4–179cm, PP & ABS
- [Concrete Post, Pile & Marker Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/concrete-post-pile-moulds): Factory-direct concrete fence post, wire-mesh boundary post, railway cable marker pile, imitation-wood landscape pile and cylindrical column moulds — 32 moulds from 41cm to 2.9m, PP & ABS, custom embossed warning text, OEM.
- [Concrete Rebar Spacer & Cover Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/concrete-spacer-block-moulds): Injection-moulded PP/ABS moulds for concrete rebar spacers & cover blocks — saddle, bar strip, plum-blossom, conical & round disc profiles in all sizes
- [Custom Precast Concrete Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/custom-precast-concrete-moulds): Custom precast concrete moulds from drawings, samples or photos
- [Decorative Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/decorative-drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct decorative drainage cover moulds in cobblestone, striped, notched and flat stone patterns
- [Diamond-Pattern Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/diamond-pattern-drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct diamond-pattern (raised rhombus anti-slip) concrete trench cover moulds: standard municipal covers 44-84cm (2.5-6cm, narrow 35cm trench option) and heavy long-span railway slabs 100-148cm (7-8cm) incl
- [Diversion Channel Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/diversion-channel-moulds): Factory-direct U-shaped diversion channel moulds, perforated/notched/coin-pattern flow slots, L-shaped diversion curb & gutter stone moulds and corner/water-stop fittings
- [Dot-Pattern Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/dot-pattern-drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct dot-pattern (raised-stud anti-slip) concrete trench cover moulds: Hangshaotai HST high-speed-railway tunnel covers, Tie Biao railway-standard slabs, expressway ABS project covers, thin notched walkway covers 2.5-3.2cm and 6-10cm railway covers
- [Drainage Channel & Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/drainage-channel-moulds): Complete drainage channel mould catalogue: U-drain channels, drainage covers, collection channels and diversion channels
- [Assembled Drainage Channel Liner Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/drainage-collection-channel-moulds): Factory-direct moulds for precast concrete assembled trapezoidal drainage ditch liners — base slabs, handed left/right side slabs, coping caps and L-shaped edge pieces
- [Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct drainage cover moulds for concrete trench covers, ditch grating covers and drainage slabs
- [Flat Kerb, Gutter Strip Stone & Apron Slab Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/flat-kerb-stone-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for flat kerb stones (ping shi / flat stones), gutter strip stones, round-top strip kerbs and large apron slabs — 54 sizes from 8×8 cm to 80×50 cm, PP & ABS, 1-out-2/1-out-10 multi-cavity, OEM profiles and project logos
- [Flat Stone Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/flat-stone-drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct flat stone, notched, double-notch and handle (recessed-grip) concrete drainage cover moulds — 21 catalogue sizes from 34×40×5cm to 78×40×6cm for flush walkway covers and seated ditch covers
- [Hexagonal Paver Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/hexagonal-paver-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for concrete hexagonal pavers and hexagon paving slabs
- [Hollow Hexagonal Revetment Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/hollow-block-hexagon-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for hollow hexagonal revetment blocks used in slope protection and river bank works
- [Hollow Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/hollow-block-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for concrete hollow blocks and hollow bricks
- [Hollow / Interlocking Slope Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/hollow-interlocking-slope-block-moulds): Factory-direct hollow and interlocking slope block moulds in 10 sizes: tongue-and-groove interlocking, dovetail, square locking and two-hole blocks, plus hollow ecological blocks with grass-planting voids.
- [Kerbstone & Curbstone Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/kerbstone-moulds): Factory-direct kerbstone moulds & curbstone molds: 48 slope, L-type, S-type, road curb and radius profiles
- [Manhole Cover, Sewer Cover & Well Frame Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/manhole-cover-moulds): Plastic moulds for precast concrete manhole covers: square 50x50x6 cm, rectangular 60x40x6 cm, round 5-hole sewer cover 80 cm and round well frame 68 cm
- [Manhole Shaft Ring Brick & Well Wall Brick Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/manhole-shaft-brick-moulds): Plastic moulds for precast concrete manhole shaft ring bricks and well wall bricks: curved ring bricks for inner diameters 70, 80, 90, 110, 130 and 150 cm, plus straight and corner wall bricks
- [Notched Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/notched-drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct notched (slotted) concrete trench cover moulds: standard 6-12cm, heavy deep 12-20cm PP/ABS, recessed dished, striped/dot/6-hole/square-hole/double-notch and highway-project covers
- [Concrete Paver Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/paver-block-moulds): Factory-direct concrete paver block moulds: colored & decorative pavers, permeable grass-grid pavers (hexagon planting holes), tactile blister/strip pavers, interlocking I/H pavers and patterned tiles (maple leaf, plum blossom, chrysanthemum, Spanish)
- [Photovoltaic Pier Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/photovoltaic-pier-moulds): Plastic moulds for precast concrete photovoltaic pier foundations, pile caps and ballast blocks for ground-mount solar farms, rooftop distributed PV and single-axis trackers
- [Power Engineering Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/power-engineering-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for power engineering concrete: cable trench coping, corner and curved coping, transformer platform coping, cobblestone combination moulds and ground anchors
- [Railway, High-Speed-Rail & Bridge Concrete Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/rail-transit-concrete-moulds): Factory-direct railway & rail transit concrete moulds: grid railway-emblem (Tie Biao) subgrade/cable-trench covers, HSR fence footing blocks, and bridge/viaduct I-beam & seagull railing panels and posts
- [Slope Protection Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/slope-protection-moulds): Factory-direct slope protection moulds in 21 sizes: ecological grass-planting blocks, river channel blocks with drainage holes, hydraulic capping blocks and companion sets for river banks, canals and road embankments.
- [Stepped Slope Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/stepped-slope-block-moulds): Factory-direct I-shaped (dogbone) and half-I stepped slope block moulds in 11 sizes, 26–50 cm long, including interlocking I-profile blocks with grass-planting voids for revetment and embankment projects.
- [Stepping Stone & Faux Stone Paving Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/stepping-stone-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for concrete stepping stones, faux stone paving, wood-grain walkway stones and patterned garden tiles
- [Striped Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/striped-drainage-cover-moulds): Factory-direct striped drainage cover moulds for ribbed concrete drain grates and lined surface covers
- [Traditional Chinese Architecture Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/traditional-chinese-architecture-moulds): Factory-direct moulds for precast concrete traditional Chinese architecture: roof ridges, ridge-end ornaments, Paofang wall bands & eave mouldings, gable bargeboards, wall coping, compound wall caps/antique wall tiles and ruyi/meander ornament blocks — 53 moulds in injection-moulded PP/ABS, Suzhou & Huizhou styles, OEM.
- [Tree Ring & Garden Edging Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/products/tree-ring-moulds): Factory-direct plastic moulds for concrete tree rings, tree pit surrounds, modular tree grates and garden edging stones

## Buyer Guides & Blog

- [Cable Trench Cover Moulds Buying Guide: Lift-Handle Power, Metro & Tunnel Covers](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/cable-trench-moulds-buying-guide): How to choose precast concrete cable trench cover moulds — removable lift-handle power/utility covers, metro/subway and deep-burial tunnel trough covers; sizes, seat/notch detail, PP vs ABS and OEM quote checklist.
- [Colored, Decorative & Grass Paver Moulds Buying Guide](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/colored-decorative-grass-paver-moulds-buying-guide): How to choose colored concrete paver moulds: permeable grass-grid vs solid colored pavers, reading outer/inner hexagon sizes, driveway vs footway thickness, four-piece flower patterns, tactile blister/strip tiles, 1-out-N cavities and PP vs ABS.
- [Injection Moulding for Rebar Spacers: Concrete Spacer Mould Buying Guide](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/concrete-spacer-block-moulds-buying-guide): Complete guide to injection-moulded concrete rebar spacer moulds: cover thickness, 1-out-N tooling, PP/ABS material choice, saddle/bar-strip/plum-blossom/disc profiles, 150+ pour cycle rating and OEM process.
- [Diamond Pattern Drainage Cover Moulds: Anti-Slip Cover Slab Buying Guide](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/diamond-pattern-drainage-cover-moulds-guide): How to choose diamond pattern drainage cover moulds for anti-slip concrete cover slabs, drainage trenches, sidewalks and municipal projects.
- [Dot Pattern Drainage Cover Moulds: Textured Cover Slab Buying Guide](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/dot-pattern-drainage-cover-moulds-guide): How to choose dot pattern drainage cover moulds for textured concrete cover slabs, sidewalks, road shoulders and municipal drainage projects.
- [Drainage Channel Moulds: How to Choose U-Drain and Drainage Cover Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/drainage-channel-moulds-u-drain-cover-buying-guide): A practical buying guide for drainage channel moulds, U-drain moulds, drainage cover moulds and ditch slab moulds for stormwater, road and municipal projects.
- [Flat Kerb, Gutter Strip Stone & Apron Slab Moulds Buying Guide](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/flat-kerb-strip-stone-moulds-buying-guide): How to choose flat kerb stone (ping shi / flat stone), gutter strip stone, round-top strip kerb and road apron slab moulds
- [Garden & Landscape Concrete Moulds Guide](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/garden-landscape-concrete-moulds-guide): A practical guide to concrete moulds for landscape work: stepping stones and faux stone paving, decorative breeze blocks for screen walls, and tree rings and garden edging for planting beds.
- [Hollow Block, Hexagonal Paver & Revetment Block Moulds](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/hollow-block-vs-hexagonal-paver-moulds-guide): A practical buyer guide to concrete hollow block moulds, hexagonal paver moulds and hollow hexagonal revetment block moulds — how each is measured, how to choose thickness and wall taper, and what to send when asking for a quote.
- [How Many Times Can You Reuse a Plastic Concrete Mold?](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/how-many-times-can-you-reuse-a-plastic-concrete-mould): How many times can you reuse a plastic concrete mold? Realistic PP vs ABS pour counts (50-500+), what shortens mold life, and how to verify supplier claims.
- [How to Choose the Right Precast Concrete Mould](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/how-to-choose-the-right-precast-concrete-mould): Choose precast concrete moulds by size, material, application, durability, cycle life, customization, supplier support and total project cost.
- [How to Demold Concrete Blocks From Plastic Molds Without Breaking Them](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/how-to-demould-concrete-blocks-without-breaking): How to remove concrete from plastic molds without breaking it
- [Kerbstone & Curbstone Moulds Buying Guide](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/kerbstone-curbstone-moulds-buying-guide): Kerbstone moulds (curbstone molds) buying guide: slope, L-type, S-type, road curb & radius profiles — sizes, corners, radii, MOQ and quoting.
- [Manhole Cover & Shaft Brick Moulds: How to Order a Complete Chamber](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/manhole-cover-and-shaft-brick-moulds-guide): A precast manhole is two purchases, not one
- [Photovoltaic Pier Moulds Guide: Solar Support and PV Foundation Bases](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/photovoltaic-pier-moulds-solar-foundation-guide): How to choose photovoltaic pier moulds for ground-mounted solar farms, rooftop ballast blocks and single-axis trackers: 30x20x30 / 30x30x30 piers, bolt pockets vs embed plates, fixed-tilt vs tracker foundations, roof ballast weight, PP vs ABS, and how many blocks per MW.
- [Plastic vs Steel Moulds: 5 Key Factors](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/plastic-vs-steel-moulds-5-key-factors): Compare plastic and steel concrete moulds across durability, cost, maintenance, handling efficiency and ROI for precast concrete production.
- [Power Engineering Concrete Moulds: Cable Trench Coping, Corners and Platform Caps](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/power-engineering-concrete-moulds-guide): A practical guide to selecting concrete moulds for power engineering concrete: cable trench and boundary wall coping, corner and curved coping pieces, transformer platform coping, cobblestone combination moulds and ground anchors.
- [Rail Transit Precast Concrete Moulds Guide: Railway Infrastructure](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/rail-transit-precast-concrete-moulds-guide): A practical guide to selecting concrete moulds for railway and metro infrastructure components including cable troughs, drainage channels, cover slabs and OEM rail transit parts.
- [Slope Protection Concrete Moulds Guide: Revetment Blocks, River Banks and Canal Lining](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/slope-protection-concrete-moulds-guide): How to choose slope protection moulds for hexagonal revetment blocks, river bank protection, canal lining, road embankments and ecological concrete blocks.
- [Why Zhihua Moulds Last 150+ Casting Cycles](https://zhihuamoulds.com/blog/why-zhihua-moulds-last-300-plus-casting-cycles): How Zhihua plastic concrete moulds reliably reach 150+ casting cycles under normal use, through virgin-material selection, wall thickness control and quality checks.
